name: system:development-ddl
src: permit(principal in Role::"system:development-architect", action == Action::"sql.ddl", resource) when { resource in Tag::"system:development" };

name: system:development-delete
src: permit(principal in Role::"system:development-deleter", action == Action::"sql.delete", resource) when { resource in Tag::"system:development" };

name: system:development-update
src: permit(principal in Role::"system:development-updater", action == Action::"sql.update", resource) when { resource in Tag::"system:development" };

name: system:development-insert
src: permit(principal in Role::"system:development-updater", action == Action::"sql.insert", resource) when { resource in Tag::"system:development" };

name: system:development-select
src: permit(principal, action == Action::"sql.select", resource) when { resource in Tag::"system:development" && (principal in Role::"system:development-viewer" || principal in Role::"system:development-pii-accessor") };

name: system:development-connect
src: permit(principal, action == Action::"datasource.connect", resource) when { resource in Tag::"system:development" && (principal in Role::"system:development-viewer" || principal in Role::"system:development-pii-accessor" || principal in Role::"system:development-updater" || principal in Role::"system:development-deleter" || principal in Role::"system:development-architect") };

name: system:development-unmaskable
src: permit(principal, action == Action::"sql.unmaskable", resource) when { resource in Tag::"system:development" };

name: system:development-unanalyzable
src: permit(principal, action == Action::"sql.unanalyzable", resource) when { resource in Tag::"system:development" };

name: system:development-unmasked
src: permit(principal, action == Action::"result.read.unmasked", resource) when { resource in Tag::"system:development" } unless { resource in Tag::"system:critical" };

name: system:critical-guard
src: forbid(principal, action in [Action::"result.read.unmasked", Action::"result.read.masked"], resource) when { resource in Tag::"system:critical" };

name: system:data-leak-guard
src: forbid(principal, action in [Action::"result.read.unmasked", Action::"result.read.masked"], resource) when { resource in Tag::"system:data-leak" } unless { resource in Tag::"system:development" };

name: system:activity-guard
src: forbid(principal, action in [Action::"result.read.unmasked", Action::"result.read.masked"], resource) when { resource in Tag::"system:activity" } unless { resource in Tag::"system:development" };

name: system:catalog-read
src: permit(principal, action == Action::"result.read.unmasked", resource) when { resource in Tag::"system:catalog" };

name: system:task-cancel-parties
src: permit(principal, action == Action::"task.cancel", resource) when { resource is Request && (resource.requester == principal || (resource has approver && resource.approver == principal)) };

name: system:task-wire-self-approve
src: permit(principal, action == Action::"task.approve", resource) when { resource is Request && principal == resource.requester && context has channel && context.channel == "wire" };

name: system:task-editor-self-approve
src: permit(principal, action == Action::"task.approve", resource) when { resource is Request && principal == resource.requester && context has channel && context.channel == "editor" };

name: system:task-assume-auditor
src: permit(principal in Role::"system:auditor", action == Action::"task.assume", resource) when { resource is Request };

name: system:task-assume-parties
src: permit(principal, action == Action::"task.assume", resource) when { resource is Request && (resource.requester == principal || (resource has approver && resource.approver == principal)) };

name: system:token-no-cross-mint
src: forbid(principal, action == Action::"token.mint", resource) when { resource.owner != principal };

name: system:token-admin
src: permit(principal in Role::"system:admin", action in [Action::"token.list", Action::"token.revoke"], resource);

name: system:token-self
src: permit(principal, action in [Action::"token.mint", Action::"token.list", Action::"token.revoke"], resource) when { resource.owner == principal };

name: system:workflow-request-default
src: permit(principal, action == Action::"task.request", resource);

name: system:workflow-self-grant
src: permit(principal, action in [Action::"task.read", Action::"grant.revoke"], resource) when { resource is AccessGrant && resource.owner == principal };

name: system:workflow-self-request
src: permit(principal, action == Action::"task.read", resource) when { resource is Request && resource.requester == principal };

name: system:audit-read-admin
src: permit(principal in Role::"system:admin", action == Action::"audit.read", resource);

name: system:audit-read-own
src: permit(principal, action == Action::"audit.read", resource) when { resource is AuditRecord && resource.principal == principal };

name: system:admin-approver
src: permit(principal in Role::"system:admin", action in [Action::"task.approve", Action::"task.read", Action::"grant.revoke", Action::"task.request", Action::"task.cancel", Action::"task.delete"], resource);

name: system:no-self-approval
src: forbid(principal, action == Action::"task.approve", resource) when { principal == resource.requester } unless { context has channel && (context.channel == "editor" || context.channel == "wire") };

name: system:admin
src: permit(principal in Role::"system:admin", action in [Action::"admin.datasources",Action::"admin.policies",Action::"admin.identity"], resource);
